adaptations: The exact supplied mark is reproduced as-is: graphite body and dusty-pink inset, with its own lighting and soft edges. The app and launcher keep the brand-black ground; no recolouring or vector reinterpretation was applied.
The wordmark 'peachy.' is live Material text at headlineMedium in Onest SemiBold 600 with a primary-coloured period; the banners set the same wordmark in Onest SemiBold.
Legacy mipmap rasters remain for older launchers only; minSdk 26 resolves the adaptive layers in mipmap-anydpi-v26.
